title: Fields in practitioner_account_screening.csv
description: Documentation for the screening log accompanying the public AI-assisted Lean account table.

columns.candidate_id: Stable local identifier for the screened source.
columns.screened_on: Date on which this screening decision was recorded.
columns.date: Publication date when known; may be a year or year-month.
columns.author: Named author(s) of the source.
columns.title: Source title or concise public description.
columns.source_type: Source category used by the account table.
columns.citation_key: BibTeX key when the source is cited or represented in the account table; may be blank for duplicates or exclusions.
columns.discovery_route: Short provenance label for how the candidate entered the screening log.
columns.decision: include_account, structured_study, related_work, duplicate, or exclude.
columns.duplicate_of: candidate_id whose workflow evidence is already represented; required only for duplicate rows.
